title: Courtesy Bonus Award by Harbison-Installed System Type (Repair and Emergency Service Calls)
content:
For the courtesy rate on a paid tune-up under Repair and Emergency Service Calls, a courtesy-program customer earns a courtesy bonus award for a system Harbison installed. The record read is the customer's installation project in closed status under Replacement System Installations, and the compressor staging of the system package it installed.

**Rule.** A customer whose closed Harbison installation installed a two-stage or variable-speed system earns a courtesy bonus award of 3 points. One whose closed Harbison installation installed a single-stage system earns 2 points. A customer with no closed Harbison installation earns no award.

| Closed Harbison installation | Courtesy bonus award |
|---|---|
| Two-stage system | 3 points |
| Variable-speed system | 3 points |
| Single-stage system | 2 points |
| None closed | None |

A project still in signed, scheduled, installed or inspected status is not a closed Harbison installation.
